How long does it take to generate a video?
Generating a high-quality AI video with Veo 3 typically takes between 60 to 120 seconds, depending on the complexity and server load. Lovart optimizes this process to be as fast as possible.
Can I control the camera movement in the video?
Yes! You can include camera directions in your prompt, such as 'pan left,' 'zoom in,' or 'drone shot.' Lovart's Agent understands cinematic terminology and applies it to the generation.
Is the video quality suitable for professional use?
Absolutely. Lovart generates videos that can be upscaled to 1080p or 4K. Many professionals use these for social media content, advertising B-roll, and pitch decks.
Can I use images as a starting point for video?
Yes, Lovart supports Image-to-Video. You can upload a static image (or one generated by Nano Banana) and the AI will animate it based on your prompt, ensuring character and style consistency.
What is the Veo 3 model?

Veo 3 is a state-of-the-art generative video model developed by Google DeepMind. Lovart integrates this model to provide users with the highest level of realism, motion coherence, and prompt adherence available today.
